setup: Setup value airtableBaseId: Airtable base id (for example appXXXX (from the base URL)). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Setup value airtableTableId: Airtable table id (for example tblXXXX (from the table URL)). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Setup value recipientEmail: Recipient email address (for example you@example.com). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.

Workflow secret PINTEREST_ACCESS_TOKEN: Pinterest access token for api.pinterest.com (Authorization: Bearer <secret>). Add it in the workflow editor's Secrets panel after import; never paste it in chat.
After import, start the schedule: cdecli cron activate automate-pinterest-analysis-ai-powered-content-suggestions.

approximate.node: Create Record Within Pinterest Data Table

hints: "Create Record Within Pinterest Data Table" (record.upsert): Airtable upsert without id → CREATE_RECORD (no match-key upsert).

"Pinterest Analysis AI Agent" used agent tools in the original: Airtable2 (airtableTool). The cdecli agent calls connectors directly; connect credentials for the services those tools reached. Prefer connectors: airtable.
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect airtable: `cdecli credential create -n "airtable" -p airtable --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
Connect googlesuper: `cdecli credential create -n "googlesuper" -p googlesuper --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).

notes:
Scheduled trigger at 8:00am to start the workflow. 

This can be updated to your schedule preference as an email with marketing trends can be sent to best fit one's schedule.

Scheduled trigger begin process to gather Pinterest Pin data and store them within Airtable. This data can be referenced or analyzed accordingly. 

*If you would like to bring in Pinterest Ads data, the data is already labeled as Organic.

This is perfect for those who are creating content calendars to understand content scheduling.

AI Agent will go through Pinterest Pins and analyze any data and trends to be able to reach target audience. The data is then summarized within the Summary LLM.

The summarized results are then sent to the Marketing Manager within an email to help lead content creation efforts.
